name: Seletar Hash House Harriers
summary: North-east hash kennel — moving trails, guest-friendly run fees, and the classic after-trail circle for newcomers.
body: Seletar Hash is an active kennel for people who want the hash ritual closer to the north-east. Like other Singapore kennels, start locations move weekly — check the kennel’s social channels before you Grab across the island. Guest-friendly culture with cash run fees; walkers are often welcome. Try Seletar and Lion City (or another kennel) before declaring a home pack — humour, pace, and circle norms differ. Heat strategy still applies: hydrate and wear trail-capable shoes.
membershipNotes: Guest-friendly; bring cash for run fees. Confirm live details with the kennel.
